description: A serene, minimalist bedroom corner vignette with an artisanal organic character. The wall is smooth plaster or unpainted limewash in warm off-white, with a gentle mottled texture visible where two wall planes meet at a corner. Mounted on the wall is a wall-mounted form consisting of a terracotta-pink circular backplate, a short matte-black arm, and a tapered cone shade in speckled sand-white ceramic or concrete with a warm gold interior — casting a downward warm amber glow onto the surface below. On the floor beneath the wall-mounted form, a large rounded vessel or drum stool in heavily textured aged concrete or raw ceramic with a weathered patina acts as a nightstand. On its flat top surface rest a small stack of linen-covered books, a shallow ceramic dish, and a small stone or mineral object. To the right, the foot of a solid oak bed frame with a simple joinery-style headboard in natural pale oak is visible, dressed with a rumpled linen pillowcase and a folded throw. The floor is wide-plank reclaimed wood in a washed pale grey-white tone.
